title: Steadier Android alerts and an honest Online dot
intro: Hi there! This is a small update that makes BranchChat a little more dependable. Here’s what’s new.

items.title: Alerts survive battery saver
items.text: Messages keep arriving in the background, even with battery saver on. A quiet “Sync” notification keeps this working, and you can hide it from the notification settings step.

items.title: Save to device just saves
items.text: Save to device now only saves the file to your phone.

items.title: Faster first start after an update
items.text: The app no longer sits on a grey screen the first time you open it after updating.

items.title: Accurate Online status
items.text: You show as Online only while BranchChat is open and in front of you.

items.title: Simpler backgrounds
items.text: The Background fade speed setting is gone; backgrounds always fade at the normal speed.
